name: Humming Crystal
title: Humming Crystal
summary: A strange humming crystal and a floating Advocate spire high atop the mountain over the buried fortress city of Vasith. In the kit it is a stepped obsidian needle that rises from z 370 to a tiny summit at z 560. The Strange Humming Crystal sits on the summit, ringed by four metallic sculptures, with two exit portals beside it. The floating Advocate Spire (0x01001776, 18.7 x 18.7 x 35.2 m) hangs directly above it from z 562.5 to 597.75.

landmarks.name: Strange Humming Crystal
landmarks.note: Spawn on the summit, with blue light emitters.

landmarks.note: 0x020003B7/B8 sculptures 4 m from the crystal, and two Exit Portals.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (fort-tethana -> ayan-baqur).

shots.standingOrder: Orbit a quarter turn clockwise 46 m around the needle summit with the Advocate spire floating over the humming crystal, at the spire's height; keep 25 m clear of the rock.
shots.notes: Signature view: a quarter orbit clockwise from bearing 205 to 295, 46 m from the needle summit at the height of the Advocate spire floating over the Strange Humming Crystal (lens z 584, the summit at z 560). The stepped obsidian peak drops 190 m below, and the Dires, the buried city of Vasith's mountains and the sky turn behind the floating tower. The afternoon sun is behind the lens. shots.standingOrder: Pull back west-south-west and up from the strange humming crystal, 14 m to 72 m out, until the stepped needle mountain and its floating spire stand alone over the Dires.
shots.notes: Dronie: the drone starts 14 m west-south-west of the humming crystal, 5 m up. It flies back and up to 72 m out and 40 m up, so the crystal, its ring of metallic sculptures, the two exit portals and the floating spire shrink onto the tip of the needle, and the stepped mountain and the Dires open below. shots.standingOrder: From the summit rock 9 m from the crystal, look straight up at the underside of the floating Advocate spire turning slowly against the sky; keep 2 m from the sculptures.
